name: longform-batch-delivery
whatsNew: v8 turns "done" into an exit code. scripts/run_state.py gate returns 0=DONE / 1=RUNNING / 2=BLOCKED, so nothing can declare completion early. Adds a turn-end contract (every turn ends with DONE or RESUME, never a question) and a throughput escalation ladder that forces longer units instead of more units. Includes _selftest/selftest.py with 12 regression assertions.
